name: EPIC 210744319

text.card: A red giant 1,070 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.18 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,793 K at its surface.
